author: Symbiotic_Mutant
body:
Hello everyone and welcome!


I have designed a map in response to what players seem to desire most: rushing and block-placing. Therefore, I have devised a map to combine Parkour and rushing! Take a look at the space battle themed map which I have decided to name ZeroG:

Images:
(These are some of my favourites)







-You can view the entire gallery at: 
http://s1276.photobucket.com/user/Symbiosis99/slideshow/ZeroG%20Avicus%20Map?sort=3


Map Features:
- Perfect rushing opportunities
- Medium amount of iron with some diamond blocks
- Default Jump Boost 1! (Should the Map Devs approve; I have it set on the loadout)
- Some useful weapons for each team and one powerful set of armour (in chests) 
- Strategic building and sniping locations
- Original space-themed features with close attention to detail


Map Progress:
- Complete
- YAML in progress (working on last element: spawn protection [no team spleefing out of spawn!])
- Soon to submit to developers (for review)


Resources Section For MapDevs:
========================================================================

Map Download:
http://www.mediafire.com/download/4udncxd71lxvx38/ZeroG.rar


Map YAML:
http://pastebin.com/du3WQPBc

========================================================================

Map Features: (for Map Developers to review)
- Map Size: 200 * 100 * 50 (Approximations)
- Map Time: 18000 ticks (Perfect moon position, stars + darkness contribute to space look)
- Effects: Jump Boost I (Adds a low-gravity feel [Map name is ZeroG, kind of reflects this and makes rushing and Parkour easier])


Map Contributor(s):
- MLGPorky (his videos inspired me to create a map ideal for block-placing)



Let me know what you think! Hopefully we can now enjoy a map with a space battle theme!

replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body:
Sorry for the bump, but something to look out for is to make sure that the coordinates in the YML don't have spaces in them, otherwise the server will crash.

For example, don't have 
spawn: 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
Instead, use
spawn: 0,0,0,0,0
